title: Dimension Traveler
next_chapter_hook: The figure of the dimensional being faded from the rift, but that cold voice clung to him like a bone-deep ailment—when the day of cleansing arrived, Chen Ji realized the true chess game had only just begun.

text.content: When the truth of the first path was revealed, Chen Ji understood that the price of so-called freedom was everything he most dreaded losing—Chen Nian's life, the survival of Tianqing Sect, and the final shred of dignity as a chess piece.

He stood alone on the edge of Tianjue Cliff, the night wind cutting like a blade, slicing through his perpetually calm mask. The shattered Tianji Record in his hand emanated a cold, eerie glow, as if mocking how all his past stratagems were merely an ant attempting to shake a tree.

Just then, a tear appeared in the heavens above. Not thunder, not a rift, but an unnatural 'fold'—as if someone had crumpled the entire sky into wrinkles, tearing open a passage to the unknown within those folds.

From that passage drifted a wisp of aura, and Chen Ji's pupils constricted—it was neither spiritual energy nor demonic energy, but something more fundamental he had never encountered. Had the Tianji Record not frantically warned in his Mental Sea, he would not have been able to sense the other's presence at all.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The voice did not come from the passage, but resounded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, "The host of the Tianji Record is more... resilient than I anticipated."

text.content: A phantom stepped out from the rift. It had no form, yet countless geometric patterns swirled around it—triangles, squares, and multidimensional structures humanity had yet to name. Chen Ji felt dizzy, as if his mind was overloading.

Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the surging blood and qi, asking coldly: "Who are you?" He instinctively tried to invoke the Tianji Record to foresee the future, but discovered in horror that everywhere the Tianji Record reached was blurred garbled text.

dialogue.content: The phantom emitted wave-like laughter: "Three-dimensional beings are indeed interesting. What you call 'Heavenly Dao' is merely a thin membrane to us. And you..." It paused, "are the only crack in that membrane."

text.content: A flash of light crossed Chen Ji's eyes, but his heart churned with terrifying waves. Three-dimensional beings? A membrane? This meant that the so-called Three Realms—humans, ghosts, immortals—were merely pieces on a higher-dimensional chessboard. And the Tianji Record he prided himself on was merely a "crack" in others' eyes.

choice.prompt: The dimensional being's gaze made Chen Ji feel like he had a thorn in his back; he had to respond—

choices.text: Retreat to advance, test the bottom line
choices.description: Do not engage directly, first extract more information to understand the other's true purpose
choices.risk_hint: The dimensional being may see through his intentions
choices.process_label: Chen Ji turns defense into offense

text.content: Chen Ji slowly收敛气息, adopting an almost humble posture with a slight bow: "Since the elder calls me a crack, surely this elder has other designs on this 'membrane.' The junior is merely a discarded piece—what merit do I possess to make the elder personally appear?"

dialogue.content: The dimensional being seemed quite intrigued by his response: "Discarded piece? No, you are the only character written askew in this script. It is your existence that adds three points of uncertainty to our plan."

choices.text: Face the interrogation directly, compete for initiative
choices.description: No longer hide your edge, directly demand the true purpose of dimensional invasion
choices.visible_reward: Display an unyielding yet respectful attitude
choices.risk_hint: The dimensional being's power far exceeds imagination

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, and the eyes that were usually mild erupted with fierce cold light: "Since the elder has seen through everything, why bother asking who I am like a hypocrite? The Three Realms are chess pieces to you—so I, Chen Ji, shall become the variable on this chessboard."

dialogue.content: The Dimensional Visitor's surrounding patterns suddenly accelerated their rotation: "Interesting. Rare courage among three-dimensional beings. But do you know, the courage you take pride in is nothing more than courage code written by higher dimensions?"

choices.text: Responded with silence, secretly on guard
choices.description: Not easily revealing one's stance, observing the opponent's flaws in silence
choices.visible_cost: May be despised by the opponent
choices.visible_reward: Keep one's trump card, quietly wait for the right moment
choices.risk_hint: Silence may be seen as cowardice

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely standing there quietly, his gaze like an ancient well without waves. Only the fist secretly clenched in his sleeve exposed the turbulence within—this was the first time he encountered an existence that even the Tianji Record could not peer into.

dialogue.content: The Dimensional Visitor seemed amused by his silence: "Indeed someone chosen by the Tianji Record. Knowing when to shut up. But I can tell you—silence changes nothing, the fate of the Three Realms is already sealed."

text.content: The Dimensional Visitor's form drifted unpredictably through the void, countless geometric patterns weaving an intricate web: "You must have already discovered. The more complete the Tianji Record becomes in your hands, the stronger the Heavenly Tribulation's backlash. Because—" its voice turned icy cold, "you are tearing apart the cage it meticulously constructed."

Chen Ji's heart sank. He recalled the toll his body endured each time he used the Tianji Record—the excruciating pain of his spirit seemingly torn apart after the Heavenly Fate Value drained, was not merely simple karma, but deliberate punishment.

dialogue.content: "So," the Dimensional Visitor shifted its tone, "we can make a deal. Help us break this cage, and all resources of the Three Realms—Spirit Veins, Secret Realms, Ancient Legacies—will open to you. You can become a true free being, rather than a caged beast biting other caged beasts."

choice.prompt: The bait cast by the Dimensional Visitor was too tempting, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Even if it means death, cannot become an accomplice to the destruction of the Three Realms
choices.visible_cost: May be killed on the spot
choices.risk_hint: The Dimensional Visitor may wipe him out on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of determination: "Senior may have found the wrong person. Though I, Chen Ji, am trash, I still know what a bottom line is. How could the billions of living beings in the Three Realms be traded for one person's freedom?"

dialogue.content: The patterns surrounding the Dimensional Visitor abruptly stilled, as if not expecting him to be so straightforward: "Interesting. An anomaly among three-dimensional beings. But do you think you have the qualification to refuse?"

choices.text: Play along while hiding one's true intentions
choices.description: Pretend to agree, but secretly seek a way to break the situation
choices.visible_reward: Strive for time, probe the true situation
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will face endless doom

text.content: A gleam of sharpness flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, then vanished: "What Senior said... does have some merit. However, there is one thing this junior doesn't understand—what benefit does this so-called deal hold for Senior?"

dialogue.content: The dimensional visitor seemed quite satisfied with his 'opportunism': 'Clever. The spiritual energy of the Three Realms is merely a drop in the ocean to us, but the Heavenly Dao itself—what lies behind that membrane—is what we truly desire.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Heavenly Dao itself? That terrifying existence that treated generations of seers as chess pieces and manipulated the fate of the Three Realms—was merely something 'desired' in the dimensional visitor's words? Then whose chess piece was the so-called Eye of Heavenly Dao?

The dimensional visitor seemed to see through his thoughts, a low laugh echoing from the illusion: 'Now you understand. The Heavenly Dao you resist, the Tianji Record you rely on, even the freedom you seek—nothing more than layers upon layers of chess games. And you, forever at the very bottom.'

dialogue.content: Its voice suddenly turned chillingly cold: 'But we are different. We come from beyond dimensions, unbound by any rules. If you are willing to cooperate, I can tell you—how to jump out of this chessboard.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-penetrating chill. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng once said—'The truth of the Tianji Record is far more terrifying than you imagine.' Now he finally understood what that terrifying meant.

choice.prompt: The dimensional visitor's words were like a key, unlocking Chen Ji's deepest fears. He had to decide how to respond next—

choices.description: Trust no promises; must witness the truth beyond dimensions with his own eyes
choices.risk_hint: The dimensional visitor might take the chance to strike at him

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm: 'Senior's words are indeed startling, but this junior never blindly believes. Could this junior witness with his own eyes—what lies beyond the dimensions?'

dialogue.content: The dimensional visitor fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a strange laugh: 'Interesting. You are the first three-dimensional being I've encountered who dares to make such a request. Very well, I shall grant your wish—but the price is one you can never bear.'

choices.description: Some truths shouldn't be known by mortals; maintaining ignorance is also a survival wisdom
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to understand the truth
choices.risk_hint: May never know who the true enemy is

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes, his voice deep: 'Not necessary. There are things that, once seen, can never be unseen. This junior would rather be an ignorant ant than a madman who knows everything.'

dialogue.content: The dimensional visitor's illusion surged violently: 'Foolish! It is precisely this ignorance that keeps all beings of the Three Realms forever trapped in samsara! However—' Its tone suddenly became playful, 'You are actually more... unique than I anticipated.'

text.content: The dimensional visitor's figure began to slowly dissipate, and the rift connecting to the heavens was also gradually healing. But before completely vanishing, it left one final statement—

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, no matter which path you choose—resistance, cooperation, or escape—the day of dimensional cleansing will ultimately arrive.届时，这片薄膜上的一切都将被抹平重来。而你，将是唯一的……变数。"

text.content: The rift completely closed, and the night sky returned to silence. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff's edge, his entire body drenched in cold sweat. Everything just now felt like an absurd dream, but the lingering异样气息 in his mental sea told him—it was not a dream.

He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record in his hand, suddenly noticing an unfamiliar line of text emerging on the fragment: 'Dimensional child, outside the chess game.' That was Mo Xiansheng's handwriting, but at this moment, Chen Ji couldn't determine which side this mysterious guardian truly stood on.

The night wind still cut like a blade, yet Chen Ji's heart felt colder than the wind itself. The so-called freedom carried a price that would destroy everything he swore to protect. The so-called truth was merely the tip of the iceberg in an even grander game. He raised his head to gaze at the starry sky, as if seeing countless eyes from higher dimensions watching him.
